title: The scariest AI deepfake you have ever seen

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What’s the most unsettling AI deepfake you’ve encountered, and why does it haunt you?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: High-fidelity voice cloning can mimic loved ones, tricking people into sending money or sensitive info — it’s already been used in scams.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: The real danger lies in political manipulation — deepfakes of leaders making false statements could incite violence or destabilize nations.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We’re developing watermarking and detection tools using neural hashes and metadata to flag AI-generated media at scale.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With global standards on AI ethics and transparency, we could build a future where deepfakes are clearly marked and used responsibly.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with accountability — shaping AI’s role in truth and trust.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a deepfake video on the left and a detection tool highlighting its artificial nature on the right.
